answered.sql: SELECT T2.national_park_id, T2.trail_id, T3.difficulty FROM National_Parks_Trails AS T2 JOIN Trails AS T3 ON T2.trail_id = T3.trail_id

candidates.meaning: Return a list of trail IDs and difficulties for each national park.
candidates.sql: SELECT NP.name, T.trail_id, T.difficulty FROM National_Parks NP JOIN National_Parks_Trails NPT ON NP.park_id = NPT.national_park_id JOIN Trails T ON NPT.trail_id = T.trail_id

candidates.meaning: For each national park, list the trail IDs and their difficulties associated with it.
candidates.sql: SELECT T2.trail_id, T3.difficulty FROM National_Parks AS T1 JOIN National_Parks_Trails AS T2 ON T1.park_id = T2.national_park_id JOIN Trails AS T3 ON T2.trail_id = T3.trail_id

candidates.meaning: List all trail IDs and difficulties for each national park, including parks with no trails.
